sentences.text:
6. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the total amount of Rs.30 Las has already been remitted to respondent no.2, which fact is affirmed by learned counsel for respondent no.2.
7.
As per the terms of settlement, the parties have been able to dissolve their marriage by decree of divorce under the provisions of Section 13B HMA, 1955.
The divorce decree dated 23.05.2023 dissolving such marriage, is annexed hereto at Page 86 of the present petition.
8. IO is present in person and identifies the parties who are present in Court as well as through VC.
9. This Court has interacted with respondent no.2, who affirms the terms of settlement.
She also confirms the receipt of Rs.30 Lacs as full and final settlement and submits that she has no objection in case the aforesaid FIR is quashed.
10. This Court has perused the terms of settlement agreement and they appear to be lawful.
The parties are bound by the terms of the settlement.
11. After observing that the disputes are arising from matrimonial This is a digitally signed order.

, this Court is of the considered opinion that no purpose would be served in continuing with the FIR in question and the further criminal proceedings and it would be in the interest of justice as also of the parties and the society that quietus is put to such disputes.
12. Accordingly, FIR No. 288/2022 dated 04.03.2022 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, 1860 registered at Police Station Model Town, New Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
